rep.angle: lead with a peer company's result
rep.name: Arjun

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Priya, Arjun at HyperSale—we helped a freight brokerage’s reps improve call scores week over week. Can I take four minutes?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I’ve got two minutes. What do you mean by “call scores,” and which freight brokerage?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: They’re AI roleplay scores for discovery, objection handling, and close, each tied to the exact quote. I can’t name the brokerage due to confidentiality.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mm-hm. We already do ride-alongs—what would roleplay scores tell me that my managers can’t see there?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: They give every rep consistent practice and quote-backed scoring, so managers see weekly improvement before quota time. Is consistency across 60 reps a priority?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: In theory. We bought Gong and nobody used it, so why would my reps consistently use this?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Um, HyperSale gives reps realistic buyer practice and managers quote-backed scores showing weekly improvement. Would it make sense to explore this further?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: You didn’t answer me. Gong gave us visibility too, and nobody used it—what specifically makes adoption different here?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Uh, unlike Gong, this is short, active practice before calls, with immediate quote-backed feedback and weekly manager visibility. Could we set up a follow-up?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Maybe, but “short” isn’t an adoption plan. Is it built into Salesforce or manager-assigned, and what completion rates do customers actually see?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Uh, I need to confirm the Salesforce workflow and completion-rate data rather than guess. Could we set up a follow-up to explore?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Before I put time on the calendar, what does it cost for 60 reps?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Uh, pricing varies by rollout and plan, so I’d rather confirm after understanding your setup. Could we reconnect sometime next week?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: No—if you can’t give me even a price range or answer the adoption questions, I don’t have a reason to put time on the calendar. Alright, I’ve got to run.
